verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Left side and the first right-hand term agree literally: p.radial is Pi_n', inverseSquare C = (C^2)⁻¹ = C^{-2}, and convolution n (phi_i phi_j) is the sum over i+j=n. The last term is encoded as -omegaQuotient/2 with omegaQuotient instantiated by previousOmegaDivX, i.e. by omegaDivX h U v (n-1), an explicitly X-division-free formula, rather than by the literal quotient Omega_{n-1}/X. The rewriting is omega_axisFactor (AxisSourceRegularity.lean:133): for V_j = X v_j, omega h U V (n-1) w = w.1 * omegaDivX h U v (n-1) w, so for X ≠ 0 omegaDivX = Omega_{n-1}/X and -omegaQuotient/2 = -Omega_{n-1}/(2X) exactly; omega_quotient_eq (line 154) states this division form. The Lean choice additionally supplies the smooth value at X = 0, where the paper's quotient is only defined by the regularity argument on p. 47.
